reason: B is the better, though still incomplete, proposal because silicon-assisted liquid-phase sintering and formation of an oxidation-limiting silica/silicate scale are physically plausible and testable below 1700 °C. A is undermined by its own evidence: B4C melting/eutectic liquid formation was reported only above about 2723 K and used at 3000 K, so its asserted liquid-phase mechanism cannot support the specified sub-1700 °C processing.
